stem.text: What is correct about the synthesis and release of the glycoprotein mucin in goblet cells?

items: The protein is produced on ribosomes and a carbohydrate chain is added in the Golgi body.
The glycoproteins are packed into vesicles in the Golgi body forming lysosomes.
Secretory vesicles containing the glycoprotein move from the Golgi body and fuse with the cell surface membrane.
